# opnsense_nginx_proxy_cache_valid (Data Source)

nginx cache validity rules (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ HTTP(S) ▸ Cache Validity**, plugin `os-nginx`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx cache validity rule.

### Read-Only

- `code` (Set of String) Enter a Respone codes or use "any" to cache any responses.
- `description` (String) Brief description for reference.
- `valid` (Number) Specify caching time in minutes.
